documents.description:
scripts/pds-ledger-census.sh:291 is `exec python3 - "$@" <<'PYEOF'`. Reading the program from stdin makes sys.path[0] the CURRENT WORKING DIRECTORY, so any *.py in the CWD whose name collides with a transitively-imported stdlib module is EXECUTED by the instrument that certifies this epic's round. Measured this wave: the shadowable surface is 49 names (not one), reached through urllib.error -> urllib.response -> tempfile -> random -> bisect and friends; 23 of the 49 execute the stray file's top-level code WHILE STILL EXITING 0, so the dangerous case leaves every exit code correct (--help rc=0, a usage error rc=3) and only a sentinel assertion can see it. That is this epic's own law aimed at its own instrument. It has been reproduced BY ACCIDENT three separate times, once inside this wave, and one accidental reproduction issued four live `bp doc mutate` writes against guerrilla before Python's own import failed.

THE FIX IS ONE TOKEN AND IT IS PROVEN BY MUTATION: `exec python3 -I - "$@"`. Measured matrix on the UNMODIFIED 106-check selftest: clean CWD unpatched PASS 106; hostile CWD unpatched FAILED 103 of 106 with 103 stray executions; -I patched PASS 106 from BOTH directories with 0 stray executions. Line count unchanged. `-I` implies `-E` and `-s`; the census reads env only at :1067-8 (BARKPARK_SERVER/BARKPARK_TOKEN, which survive -E) and `grep -c PYTHON` over the file is 0. The encoding worry does not merely fail to materialise, it INVERTS: with PYTHONIOENCODING unset, -I changes stdout not at all (md5-identical in every locale); with it set to ascii/latin-1 the NO-FLAG run CRASHES on an em-dash and the -I run succeeds. DO NOT propose `-P` — it is 3.11+ and this host's python3 is 3.9.6 (`Unknown option: -P`). DO NOT build the 'refuse by name when the CWD shadows something we import' alternative — the surface is 49 names, it grows the moment a later slice adds an import, and it would red on innocent repositories. Isolation removes the class; detection enumerates it.

THE REAL WORK IS THE FIXTURE, NOT THE FLAG. `grep -Eic 'shadow|sys\\.path|isolat|PYTHONPATH' scripts/pds-ledger-census_test.sh` is 0 today: the harness that exists to prove this census can RED has ZERO coverage of the defect class being fixed. Shipping -I alone makes this row's own disposition reason exactly the unfalsifiable claim wave 28 exists to kill. Splice a new `expect_isolated` check in the selftest's own idiom (alongside expect_status) after the control block, taking the suite 106 -> 107, using TWO strays (bisect.py AND random.py) so the fix is proven a property of the interpreter launch rather than a bisect-shaped patch.

ONE MORE STALE NUMBER TO RETIRE WHILE YOU ARE HERE (PDS-D400): PDS-D383, this row's own description, and tooling/grip/ledger/pds-w27-census-json-honesty-2026-07-31.md:63 all say '80 checks'. The suite is 106 today. Three copies of one number that moved and no instrument noticed.
